prompts.canvas: Edit reference image 1 (the target material), using reference image 2 only as the guide to clearly VISIBLE printed paper grain at UI size. The current target is too smooth after reduction to a 256px repeating tile. Keep the target's overall average colour and brightness level, square canvas, flat top-down lighting, seamless repetition and full opaque coverage. Add unmistakably visible real paper pulp fibres, short irregular fibre threads and fine scattered print flecks, with the readable natural grain intensity of reference 2. IMPORTANT: design the texture to survive reduction from ~1254px to 256px: use visible medium-scale fibres about 15–50 source pixels long, 4–10 source pixels thick, and irregular grain flecks about 6–14 source pixels, with restrained but clear tonal contrast. NOT subpixel dust. At final 256px it must visibly read as textured paper, not a smooth flat colour or blurry clouds. Keep broad tone very even. No text, graphics, lines, border, shadow, gradient, vignetting, folds or objects. This is the darkest of the three neutral paper levels, a warm stone/kraft canvas, average #c4b194. Clear tactile coarse-pulp grain with grey-brown fibre threads; preserve the muted stone colour.
